name: EPSY 5515
title: Professional Seminar in Cognition and Instruction
description: A professional seminar designed to present topics, paradigms, models, and theories in the various fields of educational psychology. The current research programs of the graduate faculty in Cognition and Instruction are presented for discussion in a seminar format. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
